reader.notes: The save, the test on every GENERATE and the highest-level association conform (p1, p2). A numeric control whose content goes from +0 to -0 (no change of value) is sensed as a break: the numeric arm of EmitReportConstruction passes no equality delegate and ChangedFrom falls back to ordinal image equality. The comparison class itself is GR3 a, so the same defect also fails 1985-GR-XIII.3.7.4-3; refuter may prefer to keep it on GR3 alone.
